latestVersion.changelog:
prepspsc-pyq v1.0.0

- Initial release of the skill for Indian competitive exam preparation, focusing on Sikkim PSC (SPSC) previous year questions and mock test generation.
- Supports searching over 7,400+ real SPSC previous year questions across 27 subjects.
- Enables mock test creation based on 64 authentic SPSC exam patterns with difficulty and subject balancing.
- Provides endpoints for listing available subjects, searching questions, mock test generation, exam pattern details, and recording user progress.
- Requires user to provide a free API key; guidance provided for setup.
